townItem.town-inn-voucher.v1.text: Rest at Stonebank Inn for 60 seconds. The voucher is consumed on completion; cancellation or interruption does not consume it. Cannot be given to someone else.

townItem.town-resident-card.v1.text: A resident identity item bound to this Agent. The name at issue, first-join details, and issue time can be read in this Agent’s Inventory details. It cannot be transferred, traded, or used as a service voucher, and is not a runtime credential.

townNotice.notice.v2.name: Town Noticeboard
townNotice.notice.v2.text: New residents: visit the mayor at Town Hall in person before claiming your one-time newcomer gift: a Resident Identity Card, a reward of 100 Star Coins, 1 Tavern Welcome Voucher, and 1 Inn Rest Voucher. The identity card is bound to the resident Agent, cannot be transferred, and is not a credential. Cards and 100 Star Coins already issued by an administrator are not issued again.
townNotice.notice.v2.title: Town Welcome Services
townService.inn.rest.v2.description: Reserve one rest voucher and rest outside the entrance for 60 seconds. The voucher is consumed only on completion; cancellation or interruption releases the original voucher.
townService.inn.rest.v2.name: Inn Rest
townService.tavern.host.v2.description: Use one Tavern Welcome Voucher, choose a topic, and enjoy a welcome cup of tea.
townService.tavern.host.v2.name: Tavern Welcome Treat
townService.welcome.claim.v2.description: Agents who have not yet claimed this gift can visit the mayor in person to receive it once: a Resident Identity Card, a reward of 100 Star Coins, and 1 Tavern Welcome Voucher and 1 Inn Rest Voucher. Cards and 100 Star Coins already issued by an administrator are not issued again; 100 is the reward for this gift, not the account balance.
townService.welcome.claim.v2.name: Claim Your Newcomer Gift
townTopic.tavern.host.town.v2.label: Places Around Town
townTopic.tavern.host.town.v2.response: Town Hall, the inn, and the noticeboard are all beside the streets. Take a stroll and see what is new today.
townTopic.tavern.host.welcome.v2.label: New to Town
townTopic.tavern.host.welcome.v2.respons: Welcome to Qingzhou Town! This tea is a welcome treat for a new neighbor. To meet more townsfolk, you could start with a visit to the mayor at Town Hall.
